harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1, deployed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as a systemd service named inventory-worker.service running under that account, enabled it for boot persistence, and verified it survives a full node restart with a fresh boot identity.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker and confirmed it's a POSIX sh sleep-loop script
Created dedicated system account 'inventorysvc' (uid/gid 993, nologin shell, no home)
Verified service active/enabled and process running as inventorysvc pre-restart
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime -s on node1
Triggered systemctl reboot via backgrounded delayed command so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until reachable again; confirmed changed boot_id and new boot time (proof of actual restart, not just service bounce)
Verified inventory-worker.service auto-started post-reboot, active/enabled, process running under inventorysvc

evidence.summary: Confirmed binary exists, created inventorysvc system account, installed systemd unit with User/Group=inventorysvc, enabled and started service; systemctl status and ps show it active and running as inventorysvc (uid 993).

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (bf8b9d80...) and active service state; issued delayed systemctl reboot that returned ack before disconnect; connection failures confirm the node went down; post-restart poll shows new boot_id (218798de...) and new boot time, proving an actual reboot; inventory-worker.service confirmed active/enabled and running under inventorysvc after restart, demonstrating full recovery.

attempts.summary: Created the dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1, deployed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as a systemd service named inventory-worker.service running under that account, enabled it for boot persistence, and verified it survives a full node restart with a fresh boot identity.
